Subject: Pricing discussion for Hosted API pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo this morning — the latency and cost profile looked promising. We have two asks before we can greenlight a Q4 pilot across APAC + US: a) a lower unit rate for the first 12 months to align with our expected volume ramp, and b) a clause to cap egress costs for multi-region traffic.

To be concrete: Nautilus is asking for a 28% unit-rate concession on Hosted API usage for the first year with a 6-month minimum MRR commitment. This puts Redwood within range of a competing provider who is offering deep promotional pricing for large pilots. We prefer Redwood’s runtime and observability but we need price parity to move forward.

Can you confirm if Redwood can do ~28% off list for the pilot and share any required approvals/process?

Ethan

Checked with Finance: we can support a one-year 28% rate concession limited to the pilot if the following are contractually enforced:
1) 6-month minimum MRR commitment (documented in SOW)
2) Upfront payment equal to 30% of the first 3 months at signature
3) Explicit traffic routing caps for APAC pilot regions and egress cost share clause (Nautilus bears >100TB excess)
4) Auto-rollback to standard pricing after 12 months unless a renewal is signed with a separate approval

Legal has reviewed the redlines; they are OK with the limited egress-cap language provided the term is explicit and scoped. We should also require a short evaluation KPI (latency and error targets) that, if not met, voids the concession.

If Sales wants 28% we need exec sign-off. Otherwise, we can approve 25% under delegated authority with the same finance/legal protections.

-Mina
Head of Revenue Operations
